svg.text: #588 Enterprise Batch LLM Inference & Nightly ETL: Tidal GPU Backfill vs. Cloud Batch API
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 4.22x Throughput Boost (4,850 vs. 1,150 tok/s/GPU) via Prefix-Sorted Offline Batching · $0.019/1M Tokens (-97.5%)
1. Why Offline Batch Mode Runs 4.22x Faster per H200
Daytime Online SLA Mode (08:00–22:00 · TPOT <= 18ms Cap)
• Batch size capped at B <= 48 to protect interactive P99 ITL/TPOT
• Throughput per H200: 1,150 tok/s · Nighttime (22:00–06:00) Idle Rate: 78%!
Nightly Tidal Offline Batch Mode (22:00–06:00 · Ray Data + vLLM Offline)
• 1. Relax TPOT Cap: Raise max_num_seqs = 512 + FP8 KV Cache → Saturate Tensor Cores
• 2. Global Prefix Sorting: Sort Parquet rows by System Prompt/Template ID (96% KV Hit)
• 3. Length Bucketing: Group similar prompt/output lengths (-38% tail straggler stall)
• Throughput per H200 jumps to 4,850 tok/s (4.22x speedup over online mode!)
• 6 Idle H200 GPUs × 8 Hours = 838M Tokens/Night at ZERO additional GPU CapEx!
2. Three Batch ETL Architectures (500M Tokens/Night = 15B/Mo)
A. Cloud Managed Batch API (Azure OpenAI / Bedrock 50% Batch Discount)
• 24h SLA turnaround · Blended $0.75/1M tokens → $11,250/mo @ 15B tokens
• Best when enterprise has zero existing PTU or self-hosted GPU clusters
B. Dedicated Spot GPU Cluster (Ray Data + vLLM on 4× Spot H100)
• Parquet row-range checkpointing every 5,000 rows survives Spot preemption
• Cost: $3,100/mo ($0.207/1M tokens, -72.4% vs. Cloud Batch API)
C. Nightly Tidal Backfill on Existing Online H200 Pool [PRIMARY]
• Drains 6 of 8 online H200 GPUs at 22:00 into Kueue Low-Priority Batch Queue
• Processes 500M tokens in 4.77 hours · Incremental Cost: $285/mo ($0.019/1M, -97.5%!)
• Instant preemption restores online pods in <15s if nighttime traffic spikes
3. Ray Data + vLLM Offline Pipeline Golden Rules
• Always sort input Parquet tables by (system_prompt_hash, char_length_bucket) before feeding vLLM to boost Prefix Hit from 31% to 96.4%.
• Decouple CPU Parquet tokenization/JSON validation workers from GPU actors via Ray Data streaming backpressure.
